title: Determination 2014/038: hoist and removable ramp or stairs as accessible route to the main pool, Coastlands Aquatic Centre, Paraparaumu
jurisdiction: New Zealand (MBIE determination under the Building Act 2004); comparative test only, not Alberta; NZ code references retained as written
code_edition: Building Code Clause D1 (Schedule 1 of the Building Regulations 1992) with Building Act section 118, as cited

facts.text: Kāpiti Coast District Council is the owner (applicant, through the Aquatic Facilities Manager) and also the building consent authority for the new Coastlands Aquatic Centre pool.

The matters are whether the hoist as installed to the main pool is sufficient by itself for Clause D1 under section 118, and whether the hoist with a removable ramp, or with removable stairs, complies with Clause D1.
The determination does not consider the stairs or ramp as constructed, other than as providing an accessible route into the pool.
REACT and WPPDT made a joint application for a second determination on the access provision (the consent-and-amendments matter is 2014/040 in this set).

limitations: Decision begins on p.16 §7.1; mask p.16 for blind use.
